name: 70802 · Baton Rouge, LA
findings: ZIP 70802 (Baton Rouge) has 239 nonprofit organizations. 104 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 81 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 70802 (Baton Rouge) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 70802 (Baton Rouge) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 81 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
